timing_method: Estimated word/phrase timing: eSpeak reference + MFCC DTW against actual selected-voice audio. Not verified ASR or human word alignment.
interpretation: Low-motion diagnostics are retained; shot duration and motion hashes are technical checks, not evidence of zero boredom.
review_scope: All 231 native previews generated; 47 subject representatives and selected full-resolution frames inspected, plus 17 final encode samples. Not a complete real-time audiovisual watch or independently verified word alignment.
scientific_scope: Interpretive animation, not validated anatomy, actual microscopy, measured reads or actual study-site footage.
